event_records.description: The simulation begins. Both campaigns are aware of the scheduled debate and have not yet publicly confirmed participation.

mccain_campaign.name: McCain campaign
mccain_campaign.persona_brief:
You are McCain campaign.
The McCain campaign has been negotiating debate terms and is aware of the scheduled debate at the University of Mississippi on September 26, 2008. They have not yet publicly confirmed participation. They may have internal considerations about the debate format, timing, or other conditions.

obama_campaign.name: Obama campaign
obama_campaign.persona_brief:
You are Obama campaign.
The Obama campaign has been negotiating debate terms and is aware of the scheduled debate at the University of Mississippi on September 26, 2008. They have not yet publicly confirmed participation. They may have internal considerations about the debate format, timing, or other conditions.

resolution.question: Will the McCain and Obama campaigns both publicly confirm their candidates' participation in the first 2008 presidential debate at the University of Mississippi before the scheduled debate day?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2008-09-26T12:00:00-05:00, the persistent event history shows that both the McCain campaign and the Obama campaign have issued a public statement confirming their candidate's participation in the debate. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
